units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:2">Ex. R. s. 2</cite> (Moses said to the lamb) <he>לא … מפני צ׳ וכ׳</he> I did not know that thou didst run off on account of thirst; thou must be tired &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:8">Ber. VI, 8</cite> <he>השותה מים לִצְמָאוֹ</he> he who drinks water to satisfy his thirst.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 30">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXX</cite> <he>מיתת הצ׳</he> death from thirst; a. e.
